g.text: - every required check passed on the head commit
- a required check failed on the head commit
Sort the R1 and I1 candidates by issue number
and keep as many as the free slots
- an APPROVED review of a person
on the head commit of the pull request
- each open pull request that closes an issue
from the issue in this snapshot
(I3, I4, R1 and I1, I12, I11, in this order)
Apply (in the order of the list)
I3: change the label to cumin/status/reviewing
I4: fix requests below the limit?
count one more, change the label to
a fix in the same session
hand it back to the Owner (row I4)
R1: change the label to cumin/status/planning,
then ask the Planner to split
I1: change the label to cumin/status/implementing,
If a label does not change,
try again at the next poll
I12: read the permission of each reviewer,
and when the latest review of an Owner approves
the head commit, run the merge step
I11 copies the labels of the issue as this poll
read them. A label that this poll or the end of
a run (I2) changed reaches the pull request
I11: make the labels of the pull request
